description: §18.5 block-body arm in a match VALUE-decl position (raw literal-arm path). `const r = match k { 1 :> { const base = "gr"; base + "een" } 2 :> { "red" } _ :> "gray" }`. A `{ statement* expression? }` arm must execute its leading statements and lift its TAIL EXPRESSION to the result var. Pre-fix this emitted `_scrml_tilde_N = { const base ... }` / `= { "red" }` -> E-CODEGEN-INVALID-LOGIC (no artifact).
rationale: §18.5: an arm body SHALL be either a single expression or a `{ }` block whose result is its last expression. The block's leading statements run first, then its tail expression becomes the arm value bound to the enclosing result var — exactly as a bare-value arm binds its expression. Bare-value arms (the `_` gray arm) are unaffected.
